posts.author: kR1pt0n1t3
posts.body:
Hi.
I need a small script to work with RGSS2 (RMVX) that does this.
Upon the player entering maps 80, 399, 397, 398, and 400 the script should copy all files from the Graphics\System\Tileset2 folder to the Graphics\System folder.
After that, if the next map player enters isn't one of the mentioned above, the script should copy all files from Graphics\System\Tileset1 folder to the Graphics\System.
It's the only way around the limitations of RPG MAKER VX tileset system. I prefer the one used in RPG MAKER XP. I don't know why they decided to limit the tileset in the newer version.
In any case, could someone help out flesh something? Pathing isn't a problem. It should always be the one set in the editor.
I only need the TileD file swapped, but let's make it swap all if it's not a problem (just in case in the future I need more tiles).
Through google I found that a script exists that might potentially do the things I need done, but I can't find it anywhere. Only things I found are the name and the author. It's Modern Algebra's Tileset Swap Script.
I also tried using ChatCPT but I better not post that  here. It just kept popping method errors so I just gave up. Sometimes it writes something usable and working but today it's just not working.
Any help with this is appreciated.
